facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2023-0233 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 12 September 2023 following 2 recorded events in the archive, including AF-2004-001 and RN-2011-002. The change assurance record covers 2 clauses across 5 controlled documents. The intent is to strengthen the material unwanted event control named in the documents in scope. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the material unwanted event control set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are MOC-2019-0221, PRO-MEC-021, PTW-STD-002, STD-ISO-006 and STD-PTW-001.
